mechanism_narrative: Accelerating GDP growth, as measured by the year-over-year change in GDPC1, signals a strengthening economy that will boost corporate earnings and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: GDPC1 YoY growth accelerates, but SPX 60-day forward returns are negative > 40% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5 percentage points over 3 months signals a rapidly weakening labor market, which will pressure consumer spending and lead to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE rises > 0.5pp in 3 months, but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive > 60% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) declines for two consecutive months, it signals a supply-driven slowdown that will negatively impact S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO declines for 2 consecutive months, but SPX 5-day forward returns are positive > 55% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) exceeds 5%, it signals a restrictive monetary policy that will negatively impact S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS > 5%, but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive > 60% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) increase by more than 10% year-over-year, it signals a strengthening housing market that will boost consumer spending and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: HOUST YoY growth > 10%, but SPX 60-day forward returns are negative > 40% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is below 4% and falling, it signals a tightening labor market that will put upward pressure on wages and lead to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE < 4% and falling, but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive > 60% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: When real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) decline for two consecutive months, it signals a weakening consumer sector that will negatively impact S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: RSAFS declines for 2 consecutive months, but SPX 5-day forward returns are positive > 55% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) are both rising, it signals a tightening monetary policy that will negatively impact S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL both rising, but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive > 60% of the time.
